messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: KMS decrypt errors > 5% in us-west1 (cryptolib timeout). PD:INC-99821 fired to oncall. Links: https://pd.example/INC-99821

pagerduty: Incident INC-99821: Triggered by threshold (kms.decrypt.failures rate)

sam: acked oncall (sam) :point_up: looking now

nisha: I'm seeing a spike in decrypt errors for key_id=redwood-prod-rot-2026 in us-west1. Errors look like timeouts from cryptolib v2.3.1.

sam: logs show ~1200 decrypt failures over last 5m, 503s returned from k-plugin, rate ~8/s -> sudden jump from baseline 0.2/s

leo: confirming. telemetry: decrypt_latency p95 jumped from 45ms -> 1.2s. KV cache hit unchanged. Appears cluster-side throttling or HSM queueing.

marty: any deploys/rotation jobs kicked off? Could be a rotation sweep.

nisha: There was an automated rotation job started at 2026-06-14T02:10Z targeting key redwood-prod-rot-2026 -> staging state. Might overlap with heavy inference jobs.

sam: PagerDuty note: escalating to infra (level2) and runtime. tagging @leo @marty.

leo: I'm looking at the HSM/API rate limits. HSM reported transient 429 + timeouts. HSM queue length spike on node hsm-usw1-3.

marty: runtime team: we can fallback to a cached-wrapped-key path to avoid HSM decrypts for in-flight requests. Short script to set REDWOOD_FALLBACK_KEY env for pods in us-west1 to redwood-prod-fallback-01

sam: can we apply fallback without rolling full fleet? Need to avoid restart for SLA customers.

marty: yes — we can update router to route requests for affected model shards to fallback path; push a config change to router-svc that toggles use_fallback_key=true for region us-west1. PATCH: 
```
PATCH /router/config
{ "region_overrides": { "us-west1": { "use_fallback_key": true } } }
```

nisha: what's customer impact before mitigation? Any errors surfaced to hosted customers?

leo: metrics: ~2.3% of hosted inference requests in us-west1 returned decrypt_failure -> leading to 5xx at upper layers for certain request patterns (long-prefix). Affected approx 14 customers, 3 with Dedicated capacity. Not a full outage but elevated errors.

sam: ok plan: 1) ack PD (done) 2) enable fallback routing for us-west1 (marty) 3) throttle rotation job / pause rotation tasks (nisha) 4) open PD timeline & notify support (sam) 5) if HSM health not improving, failover region and add capacity (leo)

marty: enacting fallback now, rolling config push to 3 router shards in us-west1 (no pod restarts). Applying...

ops-rotation-bot: rotation-runner: job rot-2026-14 reported snapshot: paused by API request by nisha at 2026-06-14T02:23Z

nisha: rotation job paused. I also disabled concurrency for queued rotations (concurrency=1).

marty: fallback toggle applied. Monitoring logs...

leo: HSM queue depth trending down slowly, 5xxs decreasing. decrypt_failure rate -> 0.6% now.

sam: support notify: "We observed transient decrypt errors affecting some inferences in us-west1; mitigation applied. No customer data exposure. We're actively monitoring and will update." Sending now.

pagerduty: INC-99821 status: acknowledged by sam; escalated to leo and marty

nisha: quick check: we should capture HSM logs + stack traces for postmortem. I'll request legal/sec to hold key material audit if rotation overlapped -> tagging security on follow-up.

sam: handoff note for next oncall: we have fallback enabled, rotation paused, HSM queue recovering. Action items: - follow HSM health for 2h - keep fallback until p95 latency normalizes - coordinate with security & rotation team before resuming rotations.

marty: and I'll prepare a safe roll-forward path: either resume rotation with backoff or route small percentage to rotated key for canary.

leo: if errors <0.5% for 30m we can unwind fallback. I'll update ops-runbook accordingly.

sam: handing off to next oncall @nisha in 40m. I'll post an incident summary before handoff. :white_check_mark:

ops-rotation-bot: Reminder: schedule post-incident review in #postmortems within 48h

nisha: thanks — keeping an eye. Will ping if any regression.

marty: marking PD incident as monitoring once error rate stable.

pagerduty: INC-99821: status changed to monitoring

sam: closing thread here, full incident writeup incoming. "Mitigation: fallback routing + paused rotation; root cause under investigation (HSM throttling + rotation concurrency)."
"Postmortem action items: rotation backoff, HSM autoscaling knobs, improve alerting to detect rotations overlapping high traffic windows."
